# hivelocity_device_port_bond (Resource)

Bonds the network ports of a device into a single LACP bond. The device must have been provisioned with bonding support (`bonded = true` on `hivelocity_bare_metal_device`). Destroying the resource unbonds the ports. The resource ID is the device ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_bare_metal_device" "web" {
  product_id    = 580
  os_name       = "Ubuntu 22.04"
  location_name = "DAL1"
  hostname      = "web.terraform.test"
  bonded        = true
}

resource "hivelocity_device_port_bond" "web" {
  device_id = hivelocity_bare_metal_device.web.device_id
}

# The bond can then be placed in a VLAN.
resource "hivelocity_vlan" "private" {
  facility_code = "DAL1"
  type          = "private"
  port_ids      = [hivelocity_device_port_bond.web.bond_port_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the device whose ports are bonded.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `bond_name` (String) Interface name of the bond, for example `bond0`.
- `bond_port_id` (Number) Port ID of the resulting bond interface. Use it in `hivelocity_vlan.port_ids`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the device ID
terraform import hivelocity_device_port_bond.web 12345
```
